name: isocad-webgl-pdf
description: IsoCad — Browser-native WebGL2 CAD & Industrial Piping Isometric PDF Editor with automated MTO, Weld Log, Cut List extraction and bidirectional API sync.
author: Trunçgil Teknoloji

scripts.build:lib: vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && vite build --config vite.cdn.config.ts
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:electron && node -e \"require('child_process').spawn('npx', ['electron', 'dist-electron/main.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: { ...process.env, VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL: 'http://localhost:5173' } })\""
scripts.electron:preview: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:appx: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win appx
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --dir
